title: Application to Study Permit Process Steps for Lithuania
notice: Lithuania has no Embassy in Bangladesh — nearest Lithuanian Embassy is in New Delhi, India. Apply via VFS Global Dhaka or in person at the Embassy in Delhi. Lithuania uses a TRP (Temporary Residence Permit) system via MIGRIS — not a standard long-stay visa.

processSteps.label: University Application : via admissions.lt or university portal
bullets: admissions.lt covers most major Lithuanian universities
Application window: March–June for September intake

processSteps.label: Offer / Admission Letter
bullets: Tuition: €1,500–€6,000/year | Lithuanian Government Scholarship can waive fees entirely

processSteps.label: Document Legalization : Double Legalization বাধ্যতামূলক
bullets: Step 1 — Bangladesh MoFA Apostille: SSC, HSC, Degree certificate ও transcript লিগালাইজ করুন
Step 2 — New Delhi Lithuanian Embassy Attestation: MoFA Apostille করা ডকুমেন্ট Embassy-তে জমা দিন
⚠️ বাংলাদেশি Apostille একা লিথুয়ানিয়া গ্রহণ করে না — উভয় ধাপ বাধ্যতামূলক

processSteps.label: Financial Proof : ~€7,000+ in bank
bullets: Official requirement: €577/month × 12 = ~€6,924 | Recommended: €7,000–€8,000
Bank statement: last 3–6 months, English certified | Sponsor letter if parent's account

processSteps.label: Book Student Housing / Dormitory
bullets: University dormitory: €100–€200/month — very affordable
Housing confirmation required for visa application

processSteps.label: Arrange Health Insurance
bullets: Mandatory for visa — minimum €30,000 coverage, entire study period
Private insurance: ~€80–€250/year

processSteps.label: Lithuanian Embassy New Delhi : National D Visa Application
bullets: No Lithuanian Embassy in Bangladesh — apply via VFS Global Dhaka or in person at Embassy New Delhi
Visa fee: €80 | Processing: 4–8 weeks

processSteps.label: Arrive in Lithuania — TRP via MIGRIS Online System
bullets: Within 3 months of arrival: apply for Temporary Residence Permit at migris.lt
TRP fee: €100–€120 | Collect TRP card from Vilnius Migration Department (3–4 weeks)
⚠️ MIGRIS Two-Strike Rule: দুইবার reject হলে system block — প্রথমবার সব documents সঠিকভাবে দিন

processSteps.label: SKVC Academic Recognition
bullets: skvc.lt — লিথুয়ানিয়ার Academic Recognition সংস্থায় বাংলাদেশি ডিগ্রির equivalency যাচাই
Double Legalized documents জমা দিন | Processing: 4–6 weeks | Fee: ~€50–€100
University registration ও TRP renewal-এর জন্য প্রয়োজন হতে পারে

costSteps.label: University Application Fee : €0–30 depending on university
Air Ticket to Lithuania : varies by season and route
